issues.evidence: Large white application panels, schematic ribbon controls, placeholder document lines and miniature slide thumbnails dominate the frames. The centered giant 'Done.' and 'Copy.' overlays resemble presentation slides.
issues.suggested_action: Give the illustrated screens a consistent, detailed application design, then frame individual actions tightly with deliberate transitions instead of repeatedly presenting entire windows beneath oversized words.

issues.evidence: The prompt close-up has visibly soft enlarged lettering; the Excel view loses its left edge; the narrow changes panel occupies a vertical strip surrounded by broad empty margins. Small truncated labels remain visible.
issues.suggested_action: Recapture the real app at higher resolution and increased application zoom, then use consistent crops that preserve the relevant file identifier, changed value and review control together.

issues.evidence: White screens repeatedly have gray darkened corners, soft halos and heavy floating-card shadows, while the ending repeats centered white/cyan type over a teal glow.
issues.suggested_action: Reduce the persistent vignette and glow, keep screen whites clean, and establish a restrained hierarchy of typography, shadows and accent colors across the UI and title cards.

issues.evidence: Both supplied reaction frames show the same frontal head-in-hands pose, striped shirt and blue office composition. Their similarity makes the emotional coverage feel recycled beside the varied human coverage in REF_bJcA23ckzcY.
issues.suggested_action: Keep the strongest head-in-hands beat and replace the other with a distinct action from the same protagonist's footage, preserving wardrobe and office continuity.

issues.evidence: The regenerated deck is a floating thumbnail strip with generic bars and gray placeholder lines; the overload frame stacks tilted application rectangles and four matching notification cards.

issues.evidence: A broad glowing red ellipse crosses the 'Slide 4 title' row beside 'THE SLIDE THAT SLIPPED / Slide 4. Caught.' The ellipse and glow resemble an explanatory markup layer.
